title: Complete Three-Model Comparison Across Two Texts
key_findings: CAMeL-BERT exhibits OPPOSITE behavior on different text sizes
Over-segments small text (1.78x) but under-segments large (0.12x)
High confidence (0.98+) is misleading - model is overconfident in both cases
Baseline v4 more reliable on large corpus despite simpler approach
Model generalization failure due to overfitting to small training text
Segment density mismatch: 4.1/1K chars (train) vs 6.6/1K chars (large corpus)

recommendations.for_small_texts: Use Gold Standard or Baseline v4; CAMeL-BERT over-segments
recommendations.for_large_texts: Use Baseline v4 as primary (32.6% recall); avoid CAMeL-BERT
recommendations.future_work: Retrain CAMeL-BERT on diverse corpus sizes with proper balance
